title: Drive time to hospitals in Buraydah: who is inside 10 and 20 minutes, and who is not

headline.label: of the estimated population within 10 minutes' drive of a mapped hospital

data: OpenStreetMap through the Overpass API on 2026-11-20: the drivable road network and hospitals (amenity=hospital or healthcare=hospital) in the study box plus a 0.08° (about 8 km) margin.
method: Study box 26.2 to 26.48 N and 43.83 to 44.12 E around Buraydah; network and hospitals come from a wider box so access is not cut at the edge.

Directed network that respects one-way streets, with a fixed speed per road class (km/h): motorway 100, trunk 80, primary 60, secondary 50, tertiary 40, unclassified 30, residential 25; links 30 to 50, any other class 25.
21 hospitals after merging points within 150 m of each other, each joined to its nearest node.
Time from each population cell to the nearest hospital with Dijkstra on the reversed network (home to hospital).
limits: Not an approved emergency plan and not an assessment of hospital capacity or specialties. Times use fixed free-flow speeds with no congestion or signals, so they lean low and real coverage is lower. The hospital list comes from OpenStreetMap and may miss hospitals or include facilities that are not hospitals; which ones take emergencies is unknown.
